answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The falcon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Work waits on the spiral until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the nectar of the next round. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
